slots.name: statue unveiling date
slots.sentence: Winfield, the first of four Hall of Famers from his hometown of St. Paul – with Jack Morris, Paul Molitor and Joe Mauer – talks about being a proud Minnesotan, where he was honored in May with St. Paul erecting a statue of him in the Dunning Sports Complex.
